`interface IDrawableModel`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`ObjModel`](/reference/drawing/objmodel/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.draw.model` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [IDrawableModel.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/draw/model/IDrawableModel.java)

A 3D model that JOID can draw and size, which renders its geometry and reports its extent.

## Description

[`ObjModel`](/reference/drawing/objmodel/) implements it for Wavefront `.obj` files; implement it for another source of geometry.
A model node reads the extent to fit the model in its bounds.

## Method details

<a id="IDrawableModel-method-render"></a>

### render

`void render()` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

JOID calls it inside [`DrawModel.drawModel`](/reference/drawing/drawmodel/#DrawModel-method-drawModel), with the matrices and the 3D render state already set.
Bind your texture and draw your geometry in model units, for example with the [`Tessellator`](/reference/drawing/tessellator/).
